title: the librarian's harvest proof runs its bin script under the host's bash, not as a Windows program
intention: Tooth 8 builds its argv with bash_script_argv(BIN), so it runs on Windows, and an AST door proof holds that no librarian proof execs a bin script directly.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: line 217 of the harvest proof execs str(BIN) directly; the shebang script raises WinError 193 on Windows
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a proof that cannot run on a box measures nothing there; Law 4: held by a scan.
how: In cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_the_librarian_harvests_cross_domain_questions.py import bash_script_argv inside the tooth and use [*bash_script_argv(BIN), ...]. Add cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_no_librarian_proof_execs_a_script_directly.py, an AST scan of the librarian proofs for a subprocess call whose argv list is headed by str(BIN).
